continuation.text:
I made one change to `src/solution.py`: I removed the rule that stopped meetings starting between 12:00 and 13:00. The current requirements don't mention a lunch break, so I treated it as an extra restriction. I haven't run the code or written any checks.

The Friday rule was already in place. On Fridays, no start time after 15:00 is returned, and 15:00 itself is allowed. This applies to "Fri" and "Friday" in any case, and to ISO dates that fall on a Friday.

Everything else is unchanged:
- The working day runs 09:00–17:00, and the meeting must end by 17:00.
- Start times are on 15-minute steps.
- Existing events block any overlapping start.
- The function returns an empty list when no slot fits.

If you did want the lunch break kept, tell me and I'll put it back.
